gloss: out of the question; beyond discussion; absurd

definitions.gloss: out of the question; beyond discussion; absurd
definitions.explanation: So unreasonable or unacceptable that it is not even worth discussing or considering.

examples.japanese: そんな{要求|ようきゅう}は{論外|ろんがい}だ。
examples.english: Such a demand is out of the question.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}もせずに{挑|いど}むなど{論外|ろんがい}だ。
examples.english: Taking it on without any preparation is absurd.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}を{無視|むし}して{利益|りえき}ばかりを{優先|ゆうせん}するなど、{論外|ろんがい}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}だ。
examples.english: Prioritizing profit while ignoring safety is an utterly unacceptable way of thinking.

notes:
Composed of {論|ろん} (discussion, argument) + {外|がい} (outside) — literally "outside discussion." Used to dismiss something as not even worth debating. Functions as a noun and as a na-adjective ({論外|ろんがい}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論外|ろんがい}だ: is out of the question
- {論外|ろんがい}な{話|はなし}: an absurd proposition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {問題外|もんだいがい}: out of the question — nearly synonymous, equally dismissive
- {言語道断|ごんごどうだん}: outrageous; unspeakable — stronger, conveys moral outrage as well
